observations: Photo 0 shows a CRT-style television sitting on a surface near a window
LG logo visible on the front bezel below the screen
Screen appears dark/blank with a faint circular reflection or smudge, not showing picture
Unit looks dusty/dirty, condition appears used and worn
No model number plate or rear panel visible in the photo
No power-on test, cable connections, or close-up damage shots provided

claims.claim: This is a scrap LG Flatron TV that is currently not functioning properly
claims.evidence: No power-on test or screen-on photo/video provided to confirm non-function or any partial function

claims.claim: Being sold as is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: Seller framing only; no internal photos showing board condition, tube integrity, or damage to support scrap/parts-only value

risks.risk: Actual functional state unknown (could be fully dead, partially working, or just needs minor repair)
risks.proof: A video of the TV being plugged in and powered on, or at minimum a photo with it switched on showing screen state

risks.risk: CRT tube could be cracked or imploded, affecting even scrap/recycling value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the screen glass and rear tube area
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case (damaged tube, parts/recycling value only)

risks.risk: Missing components (remote, power cable, internal boards) not shown
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel, ports, and any accessories included
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit with no accessories

risks.risk: Size/model variant affects even scrap material value (copper, tube size)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial sticker usually on the back panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic small-to-mid size CRT, unverified model

proof_requests: Photo or short video of the TV plugged in and powered on
Photo of the back panel including model/serial sticker and ports
Close-up of screen glass to check for cracks
Photo showing any accessories (cable, remote) included in sale
response.reason: Item is identifiable as a used LG CRT television in visibly worn condition, sold explicitly as non-functional scrap; with no proof of any working state or accessory completeness, it must be priced at worst case as non-functioning scrap/parts unit.
